name: Gem Rush 3D
blurb: Gem Rush in a meadow: animals grab gems and bump each other away. Sixty-second rounds that never stop, drawn in three.js with free CC0 models.

landing.pitch: Grab the gems. Bump your rivals away.

controls.phone: Drag to move; a second finger bumps.
controls.computer: WASD or arrows to move, Space to bump.
